title: Will Jayden Daniels need elbow surgery? Experts explain 'unusual' reinjury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will Jayden Daniels need elbow surgery? Experts explain 'unusual' reinjury
sources.description: An orthopedic surgeon called the recurrence of a dislocated elbow "really unusual" after Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered the injury a second time.
